subject: Consolidated renewal planning: GitHub, JetBrains, Atlassian
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated renewal planning: GitHub, JetBrains, Atlassian

Team —

FYI: Renewal windows for our core developer tooling vendors are clustering in Q2–Q3 (GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Atlassian). I want to propose a single coordination thread so Legal/Finance/Procurement have one consolidated plan and we can pursue multi-year / cross-vendor leverage where possible.

Quick background:
- GitHub Enterprise subscription expires: 2026-06-30 (org-wide seat-based + Actions runners)
- JetBrains All Products (seat pool) renewal: 2026-07-15
- Atlassian (Jira + Confluence) contract: 2026-08-01

Asks:
1) Karthik — can you confirm current active seat counts and whether any teams have conversions pending?
2) Marissa — can you scope possible consolidation/discount targets and priority list (must-keep features vs negotiable)?
3) Lauren — I’d like legal to prepare a single statement of objectives we can share with vendors (term flexibility, data residency, uptime commitments).

Goal: Have a vendor negotiation plan and draft procurement request ready by Jan 22 so Procurement has time to consolidate RFPs/quotes.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Head of Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0189

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal planning: GitHub, JetBrains, Atlassian

Mina —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick numbers from my side (pulled from last billing snapshot):
- GitHub Enterprise: 420 seats (active) + 15 bot/service accounts on billed seats; 55 seats flagged as inactive but still licensed. We also run ~40 self-hosted runners across two orgs.
- JetBrains: 180 active licenses in All Products pack; 12 classroom licenses.
- Atlassian: Jira (350 users), Confluence (320 users) — plus Marketplace apps (~8).

Notes / asks:
- For GitHub, we should verify runner pricing (Actions usage) separately; there's a spike in CI minutes for infra repos that might push renewal costs.
- Any plan to decommission unused seats before renewal? We can reclaim ~20 seats if teams confirm.

Vendor contacts I have on file (can be the escalation contacts):
- GitHub: Alex Tan (alex.tan@github.com) — enterprise rep
- JetBrains: jetbrains-sales@jetbrains.com
- Atlassian: atlassian-sales@atlassian.com

I can run a quick usage export for each product and share by EOD Monday. If Procurement wants a single master quote, I suggest we ask vendors for both 1-year and 3-year pricing with committed seat tiers (250/400/500).

—Karthik

Subject: GitHub Enterprise renewal — initial quote attached

Mina / Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up. I’ve attached our initial renewal quote (GH_Quote_Renewal_2026.pdf). High level:
- 1-year renewal for 420 seats: list USD 1,260,000 / year
- 3-year commit (fixed seats, billed annually): USD 1,080,000 / year (8% early-commit discount + Actions credits)
- Runner/Actions overage: billed separately, estimated $30k/yr based on current usage

We can also offer a cross-product credit if JetBrains or Atlassian are willing to confirm multi-year commitments through a consolidated procurement agreement — I'd need the procurement contact to scope that.

Attachments: GH_Quote_Renewal_2026.pdf (PDF, 450KB)

Happy to hop on a 30-min call with Procurement/Finance next week to walk the numbers.

Best,
Alex Tan

alex.tan@github.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal planning: GitHub, JetBrains, Atlassian

Thanks — I took a first pass and attached a short negotiation playbook (Vendor_Renewal_Mitigation_Plan.docx). Key suggestions:
- Prioritize a 3-year commit for GitHub if we can get Actions credits and a guarantee on runner pricing caps.
- Push JetBrains to move to a pooled seat model with automatic reclamation and a second-seat discount for contractor/admin accounts.
- For Atlassian, we should consolidate Marketplace apps under a single billing entity to avoid per-app charges and request a dev-instance exception for Confluence backups.

Concrete asks for Procurement:
1) Request 1- and 3-year quotes from all three vendors with clearly broken-out line items (seats, CI minutes, marketplace apps).
2) Ask Legal for two standard clauses: (a) data residency & audit logs; (b) termination for convenience with pro-rated refunds on pre-paid multi-year seats.

If Procurement can push a combined RFP, we might be able to secure an additional 3–5% across vendors.

—Marissa

Attachments: Vendor_Renewal_Mitigation_Plan.docx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: purchasing@redwood-procurement.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Alex Tan <alex.tan@github.com>, jetbrains-sales@jetbrains.com, atlassian-sales@atlassian.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated procurement request: toolchain renewals (see attached)

Hi Procurement —

Per alignment with Engineering and Platform, please open a single procurement packet (PROC-2026-0452) covering GitHub, JetBrains, and Atlassian renewals. Attached are initial vendor materials and our negotiation asks.

Files included: GH_Quote_Renewal_2026.pdf, JetBrains_term_sheet_2026.pdf, Vendor_Renewal_Mitigation_Plan.docx

Requested timeline:
- Procurement to issue consolidated RFP to the three vendors by Jan 29
- Vendors to return line-item quotes by Feb 12
- Objective: finalize award & PO approvals by Mar 15 so we have lead time for invoicing and any seat reclaiming ahead of June renewals.

Special notes for Legal: please prepare data residency language and pro-rated termination language that can be applied across the three agreements.

If Procurement wants a brief sync, I’m available Friday morning.

Thanks —
Mina
